## Acid Naga (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
LE Large aberration  
**Init** +6; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +21  

**Defense**

 **AC** 26, touch 19, flat-footed 22 (-1 size, +6 Dex, +7  natural, +3 Wis, +1 monk)  
**hp** 169 (13d8+65)  
**Fort** +11, **Ref** +14, **Will** +13; +2 vs. enchantments  
**Defensive Abilities** evasion; **Immune** acid, poison  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., swim 60 ft.  
**Melee** bite +13 (2d6+5 plus poison), tail slap +8 (1d8+2) or flurry of blows +11/+11/+6 (2d6+5)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** ki strike, poison, spells, stunning fist 4/day (DC 15)  
**Sorcerer Spells Known** (CL 7th; concentration +11)  

 3rd (5/day)—protection from energy, suggestion (DC 17)  
2nd (7/day)—eagle’s splendor, ghoul touch (DC 16), mirror image  
1st (7/day)—expeditious retreat, magic missile, ray of enfeeblement (DC 15), shield, true strike  
0th—detect magic, flare (DC 14), light, mage hand, read magic, resistance, touch of fatigue (DC 14)  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** An acid naga casts protection from energy on itself (usually protecting against fire) and if it has time, mirror image then shield.  

 **During Combat** An acid naga attacks with its bite and tail slap to poison a foe before pummeling them to death with flurry of blows. Enemies too difficult to hit are targeted with magic missile.  

 **Morale** An acid naga fights until reduced to 50 hp or less, at which point it retreats and goes into hiding (re-engaging for a fight to the death after its enemies drop their guard).  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 20, **Dex** 23, **Con** 20, **Int** 11, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 19  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +15; **CMD** 36  
**Feats** Combat Casting, Combat Reflexes, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Eschew Materials, Improved Disarm, Improved Initiative, Improved Unarmed Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Perception), Skill Focus (Stealth), Stunning Fist  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Bluff +8, Knowledge (local) +4, Knowledge (religion) +7, Perception +21, Spellcraft +11, Stealth +20, Swim +17  
**Languages** Aklo, Common, Undercommon  
**SQ** amphibious, fast movement, *ki* pool (5), slow fall (20 ft.), still mind  

**Special Abilities**

 **Poison (Ex)** Bite—injury; *save* Fort DC 19; *frequency* 1/round for 6 rounds; *effect* 1d2 Con damage; *cure* 2 saves.  

 **Monk Abilities** An acid naga has all the abilities, benefits, and bonuses of being a 4th level monk.  

 **Spellcasting** An acid naga casts spells as a 7th level sorcerer.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** underground  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or sortie (5-8)  
**Treasure** double
